brand.tagline: ONE WORLD. MANY PERSPECTIVES. NO STORY IS WRITTEN IN ADVANCE.

hook.question: CAN YOU CHANGE HIS FATE?
hook.visualCue: A non-graphic symbolic aftermath in the Senate: a fallen laurel wreath, shocked senators in silhouette, Caesar obscured by foreground robes, no visible injury.

rewind.label: REWIND.
frames: The Senate freezes at the moment of crisis.
The crowd and senators move backward through the chamber.
Caesar returns to the Senate steps before the danger.
Rome welcomes Caesar beneath banners and pale daylight.

player.visualCue: Brutus alone in a bright marble corridor, holding an unopened sealed letter, divided light across his face, premium historical editorial illustration.

lines: CASSIUS WANTS YOU TO BETRAY CAESAR.
BUT CAESAR CALLS YOU HIS FRIEND.
conflict.visualCue: Brutus centered between Caesar and Cassius as separate portrait panels; trust on one side, conspiracy on the other.

choices.label: WARN CAESAR
choices.strategy: Protect Caesar openly and risk exposing yourself to the conspirators.

choices.label: JOIN CASSIUS
choices.strategy: Commit to the conspiracy and accept the consequences for Caesar.

choices.label: DECEIVE THEM BOTH
choices.strategy: Send a warning while concealing your allegiance from both sides.

consequences.visualCue: Caesar pauses outside the Senate while an aide presents a sealed warning.
Cassius studies the conspirators as trust fractures across the group.
Antony gives a quiet order as guards shift position near the Senate.

productMessage: EVERY CHOICE CHANGES THE SAME WORLD.

captionVariants: Caesar trusts you. Rome fears him. What would you do as Brutus?
History chose one ending. Your Rome does not have to.
One decision changes Caesar, Cassius, Antony—and the same Rome.
